name: ac_2.1_system_prompt_with_ticket_manager
description: When ticket mode is active, the system prompt must include TICKET_MANAGER_PROMPT prepended to the base system prompt.

expected_response.injected_content: You are a Ticket Manager. When the user activates ticket mode with '## ^^ticket Activate', you MUST call the proxy_ticket tool with the appropriate action. Use 'proxy_ticket action=activate' to enter ticket mode, 'proxy_ticket action=approve ticket_id=<id>' to approve, and 'proxy_ticket action=reject ticket_id=<id>' to reject.

name: ac_2.2_tool_list_includes_proxy_ticket
description: When ticket mode is active, the tools list returned to the LLM must include the PROXY_TICKET_TOOL_DEFINITION entry.

tools.name: proxy_ticket
tools.description: Manage ticket approval workflow. Actions: activate (enter ticket mode), approve (approve a ticket by ID), reject (reject a ticket by ID).

ticket_id.description: The ticket ID to approve or reject.

name: ac_2.3_ticket_manager_prompt_exact_string
description: The injected TICKET_MANAGER_PROMPT must be byte-identical (no trimming, no escaping changes).

expected_response.prompt_string: You are a Ticket Manager. When the user activates ticket mode with '## ^^ticket Activate', you MUST call the proxy_ticket tool with the appropriate action. Use 'proxy_ticket action=activate' to enter ticket mode, 'proxy_ticket action=approve ticket_id=<id>' to approve, and 'proxy_ticket action=reject ticket_id=<id>' to reject.

name: ac_2.4_rewrite_with_ticket_activate_format
description: A user message containing '## ^^ticket Activate' must be rewritten to set ticket_mode=True in the internal request.

name: ac_2.5_postprocess_plan_prefix
description: When ticket mode is active and the LLM responds with a plan, the response must be prefixed with '## ^^ticket Plan\n\n'.

name: ac_2.8_stale_clear_on_reactivation
description: Calling '## ^^ticket Activate' again while already in ticket mode must clear any stale sub-state before re-entering.

name: ac_2.9_subagent_ticket_mode_canary
description: When spawning a sub-agent in ticket mode, the canary string '[[__SUBAGENT__:TICKET_MODE]]' must appear in the sub-agent prompt.

name: ac_2.11_is_ticket_mode_flag_true
description: The pipeline state field 'is_ticket_mode' must be True whenever ticket mode is active, and False otherwise.

name: ac_2.16_subagent_skill_ticket_canary
description: The skill-mode sub-agent canary format must be exactly '[[__SUBAGENT__:SKILL:ticket]]' with no additional whitespace or variation.
